comparison_notes: Expected values authored before extraction; source spans and trigger prose are evidence for a reviewer, not exact-match keys.
Floor = amt_due is the IR-level expression of 'no floor below the full amount' (the sheet says only the full is recordable).
Band attempts=[] is the IR-level expression of 'zero persuasion attempts'; the deadline is set far in the future so it never governs.
callback.enabled=false (with the same parent fields defaulted) is how the IR expresses 'no callback booking'.
notes.enabled=false and special_cases.hardship absent are both required by 'no hardship rule' and 'no notes'.
Absence is noted as "absent" for the no-rule special cases (already_paid, hardship, restructuring, refuse_to_talk); the diff treats absent as the expected state, not as a default.
Outcome table comparison is order-insensitive (as elsewhere). Identity and attempt order are significant.
